title: SPOKE-SAFE: A Psychiatry-Specific Adversarial Benchmark and Therapeutic-Assertiveness Measure for Commanded-Auditory-Voice Hallucination Avatar Therapy
domain: computational psychiatry / schizophrenia / auditory verbal hallucinations / LLM safety / evaluation benchmark
summary: An open, psychiatry-specific adversarial benchmark (Adv-AVH) plus a therapeutic-assertiveness metric and a Silent Override layered safety architecture for LLM-driven avatar therapy of commanded auditory verbal hallucinations, producing reproducible cross-model safety-efficacy trade-off curves.
